notes:
The repository is not a device. It is a Windows-only wrapper layer over vendor-installed IVI drivers: README.rst:9-12 ('pyivi is a thin wrapper layer that is aware of all IVI-drivers installed on a windows computer ...'), README.rst:14-20 ('not re-implementing the IVI interface using lower-level communication protocols, but rather directly communicating with the installed IVI-drivers' and 'pyivi is not cross-platform and needs to run on a windows computer'). The supported interfaces are abstract IVI APIs, not a device model: README.rst:86-93 lists IviScope, IviSpecAn and IviFGen, and README.rst:95-111 lists external IVI software modules ('Tested already on the following IVI software modules'), none of which is code in the clone.

The clone defines no concrete instrument and no fixed capability or command set. pyivi/ivifactory/__init__.py:213-218 selects installed software modules by model string, and pyivi/ivifactory/__init__.py:259-293 makes ivi_instrument() return a wrapper for whichever installed vendor driver matches. Wrapper members are discovered at runtime from the IVI session: pyivi/ivic/ivicwrapper.py:71-130 generates GetAttribute/SetAttribute properties from IVI attribute ids, and pyivi/ivicom/ivicomwrapper.py:15-30 picks properties from the COM session. The only SCPI text in the clone is the '*IDN?' model probe at pyivi/ivifactory/__init__.py:235; the library otherwise does not assemble SCPI commands, so the card's ScpiDriver/family:scpi label does not describe it.

The package also cannot be imported as a plain device library off Windows: pyivi/ivifactory/__init__.py:4-11 imports comtypes and reads IVIROOTDIR32 to load IviConfigServer.dll at import time, and pyivi/ivifactory/__init__.py:206-210 builds CONFIG_STORE and SESSION_FACTORY at import; pyivi/__init__.py:4-6 imports the factory on package import. The card's entry_symbols and models are empty. No single device, unit range, SCPI vocabulary or safety bound can be sourced from the clone, so a driver would have to invent a device and its limits. No package code was written and task.json is unchanged; no gate was run.
